g1.label: 1. When is the talent show?
g1.why: The recording says the show is on the last Friday of term.

g2.label: 2. Where will it be held?
g2.why: The recording says the show will take place in the school hall.

g3.label: 3. How do students sign up?
g3.why: The recording says to fill in a sign-up form on the noticeboard outside the music room.

g4.label: 4. How long can each act last?
g4.why: The recording says each act can last a maximum of three minutes.

g5.label: 5. What is the ticket money used for?
g5.why: The recording says the money raised will be spent on new library books.

g6.label: 6. What does Sophie want to do?
g6.why: The recording says Sophie has decided to sing a song.

g7.label: 7. Why is Daniel unsure?
g7.why: The recording says Daniel gets nervous standing on stage alone.

g8.label: 8. What do they finally decide?
g8.why: The recording says they decide to perform a song together as a duo.

g1.label: 1. Karim — plays instruments, rehearses
g1.why: The text says the band slot is for groups of musicians playing together.

g2.label: 2. Nadia — card tricks
g2.why: The text says the magic slot is for card tricks and illusions.

g3.label: 3. Ben — funny stories
g3.why: The text says the comedy slot is for jokes and funny stories.

g4.label: 4. Priya — dance routine
g4.why: The text says the dance slot is for solo dancers or dance crews.

g5.label: 5. Can add an act after 14 March
g5.why: The text says no acts can be added after 14 March.

g6.label: 6. Only one act per student
g6.why: The text confirms each student may only appear in one act.

g7.label: 7. Backing music to Mr Berg beforehand
g7.why: The text confirms backing music should be given to Mr Berg before the show.

g8.label: 8. Teachers alone decide the winner
g8.why: The text says the audience chooses the winner by voting, not the teachers alone.
